new_value: {"design":"protocol-07 §2.1 (Table 1, PR #177) makes the first path segment of a MIMI URI the identifier type: a user URI is mimi://\u003cprovider\u003e/u/\u003cid\u003e; a provider URI has no path. It does not say what \u003cid\u003e may contain. Readings: (a) any non-empty remainder after /u/, including further '/'; (b) one non-empty path segment. Chosen: (b), with no query or fragment (RFC 3986 path segments exclude '?' and '#'). The spec's examples are single segments, and failing closed keeps a user from colliding with another identifier type or with the hub's own identity mimi://\u003cprovider\u003e (decision mimid-1wgh.6.35). Applied to local users at LocalUser::authenticated (so JMAP bearer auth and KeyPackage upload) and Store::create_account, via hub::user_uri_domain. Remote users' URIs are still checked for domain only.","issue_type":"decision","title":"Local user URIs are exactly mimi://\u003cprovider\u003e/u/\u003cid\u003e (protocol-07 §2.1)"}

hub::user_uri_domain (protocol-07 §2.1; this decision) used by LocalUser::authenticated and Store::create_account. Tests local_user_uri_must_be_a_user_uri and create_account_refuses_non_user_uris failed first on mimi://a.example being accepted. No fixtures changed. Workspace tests pass in worktree.
